newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU industrial crops network launched.
newsitem.headline: EU industrial crops network launched.

text.p: A European Union information network aimed at promoting industrial uses of agricultural products was launched on Tuesday, the organisers said on Wednesday.

The Interactive European Network for Industrial Crops and their Applications (IENICA) is funded by the European Commission and aims to promote the exchange of information about research in 14 different member states.
The project, which has been granted 413,000 Ecus by the Commission, will use the Internet to promote dialogue between academics, universities and farmers.
"It is an exciting project which will cover anything from bio-fuels to bio-degradable plastics," Gundula Azeez of the British National Farmers Union said.
"It is an idea first promoted by a similar British organisation known as ACTIN (Alternative Crops Technology Interactive Network) to put the EU in the lead on alternative crop uses."
